title: Foto Gudang Industrial
prompt: Professional photorealistic editorial industrial photography, interior wide-angle photograph of a modern industrial distributor warehouse in Jakarta, Indonesia. The warehouse is well-organized with high steel racking systems on both sides, holding stacks of blue and green industrial lubricant drums (200-liter steel barrels), white plastic jerry cans (25L), and cardboard boxes of automotive batteries. Center aisle is clean and wide with painted yellow safety lines on a polished concrete floor. A forklift with a small load is positioned mid-frame, slightly out of focus to suggest activity. Bright LED high-bay ceiling lights illuminate the space with neutral cool-white tone, creating natural shadows and depth. In the background, exposed metal trusses, ventilation ducts, and emergency exit signs add authenticity. A staff member in safety vest and helmet is visible in the distance, scanning items with a handheld device. Color grading leans toward a slightly desaturated, professional industrial look with subtle dark-green and charcoal accents matching corporate B2B branding. Shot with a full-frame camera, 24mm lens, f/8, deep depth of field, eye-level perspective, ISO 400, golden-cool balanced white balance. High resolution, sharp focus throughout, suitable for a corporate distributor website hero or about page. 16:9 aspect ratio. Avoid: cartoon, illustration, low quality, blurry, distorted hands, text overlays, fictional brand logos, cluttered mess, dim lighting, fisheye distortion, unrealistic stacking, fire, damage, watermark.

title: Foto Stok Barang
prompt: Photorealistic commercial product photography and industrial documentary, close-up to medium shot of an industrial stock area inside a clean, well-lit Indonesian warehouse. Foreground shows neatly aligned rows of green and dark-green 200-liter steel lubricant drums on wooden pallets, with painted top lids and visible bung fittings. Behind the drums, a multi-tier metal shelving unit holds tightly packed boxes of automotive and commercial vehicle batteries (rectangular black cases with carry handles), plus shrink-wrapped pallets of 25-liter white HDPE jerry cans labeled for chemical use. Each pallet has a small printed inventory tag attached. Lighting is bright and even from overhead industrial LED fixtures, with subtle reflections on the metal drums. Floor is sealed gray concrete with yellow safety stripes. Composition is shot at a slight diagonal angle to emphasize depth and stock volume. Color palette is dominated by industrial green, black, white, with charcoal background elements. Realistic dust-free, professional, organized look, suggesting an active and well-managed B2B distributor. Full-frame camera, 35mm lens, f/5.6, sharp focus on the foreground drums with mild bokeh on background shelves. 4:3 aspect ratio. Avoid: cartoon, anime, illustration, blurry, low resolution, fictional logos, dusty, abandoned, broken pallets, water leaks, fire hazard, text watermark, humans in foreground.

title: Foto Produk Asli
prompt: High-end photorealistic premium studio product photography, editorial B2B style. A curated industrial product lineup arranged on a smooth dark charcoal surface against a soft gradient deep-green to black background. Centerpiece is a 25-liter dark-green HDPE jerry can with handle and screw cap (no brand name visible), placed slightly left of center. To its right, a black rectangular automotive battery with red and silver terminal posts and a carry strap, set on a small matte plinth. To the left, a 1-liter cylindrical lubricant bottle with an emerald green label section (no readable brand text). In the background, slightly out of focus, a 200-liter steel drum stands tall as a hero element. Soft directional studio lighting from upper-left, with a fill light on the right, creating subtle highlights on plastic and metal surfaces, gentle reflections on the dark surface, and elegant shadows. Color grading rich and premium, emphasizing dark green, black, and white tones with warm catch-lights. High dynamic range, sharp clarity, micro-textures on the plastic, brushed metal feel on the drum. Shot with a full-frame DSLR, 85mm lens, f/8, ISO 100. Hyper-realistic, magazine quality. 1:1 square aspect ratio. Avoid: cartoon, vector art, low quality, fake-looking plastic, harsh shadows, cluttered, multiple competing focal points, readable brand names, busy background, text watermark, distorted shapes.

title: Foto Kantor
prompt: Professional photorealistic architectural interior photography, corporate editorial style. Wide interior shot of a modern mid-sized B2B distributor company office in Jakarta. The space features clean open-plan workstations with neutral light-gray desks, ergonomic black mesh chairs, dual-monitor setups, and tidy desk accessories. A small meeting pod with frosted glass partitions sits to the right, containing a polished wooden table and minimalist chairs. The walls are a warm off-white, with one accent wall in a deep emerald green that has subtle vertical wood paneling. Large windows on the left allow soft natural daylight to flood in, mixing with warm pendant LED lighting overhead. The floor is light wood-look vinyl. Decorative greenery (a tall snake plant, a few small desk plants) softens the corporate feel. A discreet wall-mounted display shows a generic global map with subtle pin markers indicating distribution coverage (no readable text). The composition is shot at eye-level with a slight wide-angle perspective, leading lines from the desk row toward the back of the office. Atmosphere is calm, professional, productive, and trustworthy. Subtle color grading leaning toward muted greens and neutral warm tones, matching premium industrial corporate branding. Full-frame camera, 24mm lens, f/8, deep depth of field, balanced exposure. Optionally one or two blurred staff figures in the background. 16:9 aspect ratio. Avoid: cartoon, illustration, low quality, dim lighting, dirty office, broken furniture, fictional logos, text overlays, fisheye distortion, messy desks, exposed cables everywhere.

title: Dokumen Authorization / Principal Certificate
prompt: Photorealistic editorial flat-lay product photography, top-down photograph of a formal corporate authorization certificate document, presented on a smooth dark walnut wooden desk surface. The certificate is printed on premium thick cream-colored matte paper with a subtle paper texture and a thin embossed dark-green double border. The layout features a centered ornate emblem at the top (abstract industrial gear motif, no real brand), elegant serif typography reading generic placeholder text such as 'Certificate of Authorized Distribution' and a body of formal text rendered as realistic but unreadable lorem-ipsum-style script. Below the body, two signature lines with stylized handwritten signatures and printed names underneath. A round embossed gold-foil seal with a green ribbon attaches at the bottom-right corner. To the side of the certificate, a sleek matte-black fountain pen rests at a slight angle. Soft warm directional lighting from the upper left creates gentle shadows, highlighting the paper grain and the embossed seal. The wood grain shows subtle reflections. Atmosphere is formal, official, prestigious, and trustworthy. Full-frame camera, 50mm lens, f/8, ISO 100, perfectly square top-down composition. 4:5 aspect ratio. Avoid: cartoon, vector flat illustration, low quality, real brand names, real signatures of public figures, distorted text, fake-looking foil, plastic appearance, blurry, watermarks, real trademarked logos.

title: NIB / NPWP / Company Legal Info
prompt: Photorealistic editorial flat-lay corporate photography, top-down photograph showcasing a neat arrangement of generic Indonesian-style corporate legal documents on a clean light-gray desk surface. The composition includes three overlapping documents: one resembling a business identification certificate on white paper with a thin dark-green border and placeholder header text, one resembling a tax registration card layout in pale yellow tone with a small portrait window and grid lines (all text rendered as unreadable lorem-ipsum-style script), and one folder cover in deep charcoal with a subtle embossed gear emblem in the corner. Accompanying objects include a brushed metal pen, a small pair of round reading glasses, a folded pair of glasses cleaning cloth, and a tidy stack of paperclips. Soft, even daylight from above creates gentle shadows and reveals subtle paper textures and grain. A subtle hint of an emerald green leaf from a desk plant peeks in from one corner for warmth. Atmosphere is formal, organized, and credible without revealing any real personal data, names, identification numbers, or government emblems. Full-frame camera, 35mm lens, f/8, ISO 100. 4:5 aspect ratio. Avoid: real personal data, real ID numbers, real government emblems, real company names, cartoon, low quality, distorted text, pixelated, fake-looking paper, watermark, illegible mess.

title: Tahun Berdiri / Company Heritage
prompt: Photorealistic cinematic corporate editorial image conveying the heritage and longevity of an established Indonesian industrial distributor company. The composition is split into a subtle visual narrative: in the foreground, a clean modern brushed-metal plaque mounted on a deep emerald-green textured wall, with negative space where a year placeholder would be displayed (leave the metal plaque blank or with abstract numerical-looking shapes, no readable text). The plaque catches a soft directional spotlight from above, creating a refined gleam. In the slightly out-of-focus background, a glimpse of a modern warehouse aisle with industrial drums, gently lit, suggesting decades of continuous operation. Subtle warm tungsten ambient light blends with cooler industrial overhead light, creating depth and a sense of timelessness. Atmosphere is dignified, prestigious, and trustworthy, suggesting a long-standing B2B distributor that has earned its position. Color palette dominated by emerald green, charcoal, brushed silver, and warm gold highlights. Full-frame camera, 50mm lens, f/4, shallow depth of field on the plaque, ISO 200. 3:2 aspect ratio. Avoid: cartoon, illustration, low quality, readable years or numbers, real company names, real logos, distorted, generic stock look, watermark, busy background.

title: Area Distribusi / Distribution Coverage
prompt: Premium photorealistic composite scene with modern corporate visualization style, representing nationwide distribution coverage across Indonesia for a B2B industrial distributor. Centerpiece is a stylized modern wall-mounted display or large desktop dashboard showing a clean dark-themed map of the Indonesian archipelago rendered in charcoal background tones with pale outlines of major islands. Glowing emerald-green pin markers softly illuminate key distribution hubs centered around Java (Jakarta area) and South Kalimantan (Banjarbaru area), connected by faint thin animated-looking light lines suggesting logistic routes. Around the map, subtle industrial elements frame the composition: a partial view of a parked logistics truck on the right (rear corner only), a clean stack of boxed inventory on a pallet to the lower-left, and a soft gradient of warehouse lighting in the deep background. The lighting is moody and modern, with cool blue-green ambience and warm accent highlights. Color palette emphasizes dark charcoal, deep emerald, soft gold, and clean white. The atmosphere is high-tech, premium, capable, and trustworthy. Full-frame camera, 35mm lens, f/5.6, ISO 400, balanced exposure with rich contrast. The map should be clearly Indonesian in shape but free of any specific labels or trademarks. 16:9 aspect ratio. Avoid: cartoon, vector flat, low quality, wrong country shape, readable city labels, real brand names, distorted geography, pixelated, watermark, neon overload.

title: Jenis Customer / Industri yang Dilayani
prompt: Premium photorealistic editorial composite image, corporate industrial documentary style, six-panel image visually representing the diverse industrial customer base of a B2B distributor. Six harmonized scene tiles arranged in a clean 3-by-2 grid, separated by thin neutral dividers, all unified by a consistent muted color grade with emerald-green and charcoal accents. Tile 1: a manufacturing factory floor with CNC machinery in operation under cool industrial lighting. Tile 2: a busy automotive workshop with a vehicle on a hydraulic lift, mechanic tools hanging on a pegboard wall. Tile 3: a mining site with heavy equipment such as a haul truck and excavator working at golden hour, dust slightly suspended in the air. Tile 4: a logistics yard with a fleet of cargo trucks lined up at loading docks during dawn light. Tile 5: a construction site mid-build with steel scaffolding, a tower crane in the background, and workers in safety gear in a wide shot. Tile 6: a clean commercial facility lobby with polished floors, glass doors, and a maintenance worker carrying chemical supplies. Each scene is photographic, well-composed, and free of any readable signage, brand logos, or trademarked colors. Lighting is consistent across tiles, slightly desaturated and professional, suggesting a unified corporate narrative. Workers wear generic safety vests, helmets, and uniforms. Atmosphere conveys reliability, scale, and breadth of industries served. Full-frame camera quality across all tiles, 50mm lens equivalent, f/8, ISO 200. 3:2 aspect ratio. Avoid: cartoon, vector, low quality, inconsistent grading between tiles, readable brand names, fictional logos, distorted human anatomy, blurry, fire or accident scenes, watermark.
